spans.s:
mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं)
1 Crooked, curved.
2 Bent, bowed, bending, stooping.
E.
भुज to curve, aff. क्त.

m. (-र्भः)
A name of BHAVABHŪTI, the author of the Mālatī Mādhava, and other dramas.
E.
भू the earth, गर्भ fœtus.

n. (-रं)
Poison.
E.
भू, and गर poison.

m. (-लः)
The terrestrial globe, the earth.
E.
भू the earth, and गोल a ball or globe.
